title: shape fact inventory
description: Inventory of load-bearing spans extracted from a document BEFORE any edit. Every entry must survive the pass verbatim; the gate is 100%.

source_sha.description: git blob sha of the source at extraction time.

span.description: Verbatim text, exactly as it appears in the source.

grep_fragment.description: A fragment of span that lives entirely on ONE line — what verify-facts.sh greps for. Defaults to span when span is single-line.

role.description: Why the reader needs this fact: it bears on the decision, supports it, says where it came from, or records what used to be true. Set by the model, confirmed by the human before any transform (issue #5). Never set by extract-facts.sh, never read by verify-facts.sh — survival is 100 % whatever the role; the role only lets the report say what was relocated and why.
